title: Regression: Crash when importing SVG as Sprite3D texture
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in: v4.5-dev5 through v4.6-beta1 - Not reproducible in: v4.4.1 through v4.5-dev4 ### System information Godot v4.5.1.stable - Windows Unknown (build 9600) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon HD 8400 / R3 Series (0x00009830) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-21.19.407.0) - AMD A6-5200 APU with Radeon(TM) HD Graphics (4 threads) - 15.45 GiB memory ### Issue description Editor crashes when importing a texture, by dragging & dropping an SVG file in Godot 4.5.1. It doesn't crash when doing the same thing in Godot 4.4.1. And if I reopen the 4.4 project in 4.5 the texture is already applied and seems to work normally. Console output (after crash): ``` G:\Godot-4.5.1>Godot_v4.5.1-stable_win64_console.exe Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org WARNING: Your video card drivers are known to have low quality OpenGL 3.3 suppor t, switching to ANGLE. at: DisplayServerWindows (platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp:7106) OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0.0 (ANGLE 2.1.1 git hash: d8c00a9d4283) - Compatibility - Using Device: Google Inc. (AMD) - ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon HD 8400 / R3 Series ( 0x00009830) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-21.19.407.0) Editing project: G:/Godot-4.5.1/projects/new-game-project Godot Engine v4.5.1.stable.official.f62fdbde1 - https://godotengine.org WARNING: Your video card drivers are known to have low quality OpenGL 3.3 suppor t, switching to ANGLE. at: DisplayServerWindows (platform/windows/display_server_windows.cpp:7106) OpenGL API OpenGL ES 3.0.0 (ANGLE 2.1.1 git hash: d8c00a9d4283) - Compatibility - Using Device: Google Inc. (AMD) - ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon HD 8400 / R3 Series ( 0x00009830) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-21.19.407.0) res://icon.svg: Texture detected as used in 3D. Enabling mipmap generation and s etting the texture compression mode to VRAM Compressed (S3TC/ETC/BPTC). vkEnumerateInstanceVersion not available, assuming Vulkan 1.0. G:\Godot-4.5.1> ``` I feel like the problem is it's trying to auto-switch to the Vulkan 1.0 driver even though I'm in Compatibility mode. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Launch Godot v4.5-dev5+ in Windows 2. Create a new project in Compatibility mode (without proper vulkan/d3d12 drivers) 3. Open it for editing 4. Add a `Node3D` to the scene tree 5. Add a `Sprite3D` child node 6. Drag the `icon.svg` file from the FileSystem dock to either the `Sprite3D` node or the `` Texture in the Sprite3D area of the Inspector dock. 7. Witness the editor crash & close (in v4.5-dev5+, but not in v4.4.1 through v4.5-dev4) ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [new-game-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24182673/new-game-project.zip)
